dedupe_keys.name: grey brick buildings calibrated rc models of dutch residential building heat dynamics

description: Grey-brick buildings is an open set of calibrated lumped resistance-capacitance (RC) grey-box models of the heat dynamics of 225 Dutch residential buildings, with thermal characterisations and metadata. It was published on Zenodo on 6 November 2022 (version 1.0) by Julien Leprince and Wim Zeiler of Eindhoven University of Technology, Clayton Miller of the National University of Singapore, Henrik Madsen of the Technical University of Denmark, and Kaustav Basu and Rik van der Vlist of the energy company Eneco, with a paper in an ACM proceedings. The models improve on a published stochastic identification of building heat dynamics from real measurements, filling the gap in interpretable, calibrated and openly shared building thermal models. Coverage: 225 homes in the Netherlands. Access: a ZIP of about 1 MB on Zenodo and a companion code release. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10.1145/3560905.3567760) is CC-BY-4.0. Free. Caveats: the underlying measurements are not included. Simulation uses: performance benchmarks, model predictive control, demand-side management, policy assessment and data augmentation. Related records: the Eurac baseline building models and the Dutch 3DBAG.
